runs.summary: Checked all 41 tracked programmes on official pages. Key changes: Paderborn CE now requires GRE or dMAT; Saarland needs IELTS 7 + GRE/GATE; TU Delft CESE needs IELTS 7.0/6.5 + GRE and 2027/28 tuition is €26,479; TU/e Embedded Systems requires CGPA 8.5/10 for India (below 7.67); WHZ deadline moved to 30 Apr 2027; JEMARO has no 2026–28 intake; Twente/TU/e 2027/28 tuition published. Added Bremen CMM, TU Ilmenau RCSE, RWU EEES, Uppsala Embedded Systems and Linköping Electronics Engineering. Still unconfirmed: UiO (site blocked), Chalmers and Halmstad fees, TUM RCI tuition, Paris-Saclay fee exemption, EIT/SSI2 2027 dates.
